products.name: Arm
products.description:
A dining armchair in solid reclaimed oak, shaped for unhurried meals and quiet corners. Straight oak arms rest on continuous front posts and meet the rear stiles; a board-built seat, traditional apron frame and broad back board keep the construction clear and grounded. Softly eased edges bring a gentle touch to the timber’s enduring grain.

58 × 56 × 80 cm, with a 46 cm seat height and 66 cm arm height. Available in Natural or Smoked matte oil. Selected century-old boards carry their own grain, sound knots and historic markings; the gallery shows Natural oak.

faqs.question: How long does production take?
